title: Human and LLM Facilitation in Collaborative Design Meetings: A Computational Behavioral Comparison
abstract: arXiv:2610.13082v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored as facilitators of group discussion and collaborative work, but the behavioral differences between LLM-generated and human facilitation remain insufficiently characterized. We compare human Project Manager facilitation turns from scenario-based collaborative design meetings with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct responses across 199 paired contexts from the AMI Meeting Corpus. The analysis covers five confirmatory dimensions: contextual semantic distance, a lexical elaboration proxy, empathyand-hedge lexical density, topic divergence, and phase-vocabulary alignment. An exploratory directiveness measure failed domain validation and is not interpreted. The sampled human Project Manager turns were higher on contextual semantic distance (r = 0.644) and on empathyand-hedge lexical density (r = 0.203). The second contrast is carried mainly by hedge terms, so we read it as lexical hedging rather

translated_title: 协作设计会议中的人类与大型语言模型引导：一项计算行为比较
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正日益被探索用作群体讨论与协作工作的引导者，但LLM生成的引导与人类引导之间的行为差异仍未得到充分刻画。我们基于AMI会议语料库中的199个配对情境，将基于情境的协作设计会议中人类项目经理的引导话语与Llama 3.1 8B Instruct的回应进行了比较。分析涵盖五个验证性维度：情境语义距离、词汇详述代理指标、共情与缓和语词汇密度、话题分歧度以及阶段-词汇对齐度。一项探索性的指令性度量未能通过领域验证，因此不予解读。抽样的人类项目经理话语在情境语义距离（r = 0.644）和共情与缓和语词汇密度（r = 0.203）上得分更高。第二项对比主要由缓和语词汇驱动，因此我们将其解读为词汇层面的缓和行为而非……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究基于AMI会议语料库199个配对情境，从五个维度对人类项目经理与Llama 3.1 8B在协作设计会议中的引导行为进行计算比较，发现人类引导在情境语义距离和共情/缓和语词汇密度上更高，且后者主要由缓和语词汇驱动。
en_tdlr: This study computationally compares human Project Manager facilitation with Llama 3.1 8B responses across five dimensions using 199 paired contexts from the AMI Meeting Corpus, finding that human facilitation exhibits higher contextual semantic distance and empathy-and-hedge lexical density, with the latter driven mainly by hedge terms.
